_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the picker" is the skill picker [data-testid="skill-picker"]; its options are its [role="option"] elements; "the chip" is [data-testid="skill-chip"]. On a wide screen, MCP tools show short names, server badges, schemas and partial errors, and send the exact tool. The page lists MCP servers web and library, each with a tool "search" taking a required "query", and locked, whose tools fail to load. Call "posted chat" returns JSON {"skills": the last posted chat's skills, "requests web.search": whether its message starts with "echo: find sources", a blank line, then 'Use the MCP tool "web.search"'}. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/skills. 2. Fill the input with "/skills search". 3. There should be exactly 2 options. 4. The first option's ".truncate" text should be exactly "search", and its ".skill-mcp-badge" text exactly "web". 5. The last option's ".skill-mcp-badge" text should be exactly "library". 6. The picker's ".skill-picker-warning" should contain "locked". 7. The picker's ".skill-mcp-parameters" should contain "query" and contain "required". 8. The picker's ".skill-mcp-activate" should contain "'web.search'" (with the single quotes). 9. Click the first option. 10. The chip's ".skill-chip-label" text should be exactly "search", and the chip's ".skill-mcp-badge" text exactly "web". 11. Inside the chip, a button whose accessible name is exactly "Remove tool search from web" (button[aria-label="Remove tool search from web"]) should be visible. 12. Fill the input with "echo: find sources". 13. Click the send button (data-testid "send-button"). 14. Call "posted chat" with expect "{\"skills\":[],\"requests web.search\":true}". 15. There should be no chips: [data-testid="skill-chip"] count 0. 16. The last user message (the last ".message-user") should contain 'Use the MCP tool "web.search"'.
